headline: Details Announced for Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Train
summary: Indian Railways has released key details for the new Vande Bharat service connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa. Passengers can now check the route map, train schedules, and ticket pricing.

headline: PM Modi Launches Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has officially launched the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express. Regular commercial services for the high-speed train have now commenced.

headline: Goa-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Train Starts Nov 13
summary: The Vande Bharat train service connecting Goa and Bengaluru will begin operations on November 13. The service aims to offer faster rail connectivity between the two regions.

headline: FC Goa Parts Ways With Head Coach Gouramangi Singh
summary: FC Goa has officially severed ties with head coach Gouramangi Singh. The decision comes following recent developments in the club's leadership setup.

headline: Regular Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Trains From Nov 15
summary: Regular train operations for the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express are scheduled to begin on November 15. The service will cater to regular commuters and travelers.

summary: A comprehensive coastal defence exercise has been launched along the Goa coast. Security agencies are testing operational readiness and coastal vigilance.

headline: Ex-MLA Alleges Gangs Trafficking Children to Goa
summary: A former MLA has claimed that organized criminal syndicates are actively trafficking children into Goa. Authorities have been urged to take strict action against the networks.

headline: Goa Prepares for IFFI 2026 With 159 Films
summary: Goa is making final arrangements to host IFFI 2026, featuring 159 international films. Over 7,000 delegates are expected to attend the film festival.

headline: Police to Crack Down on Illegal Meat Network
summary: Goa Police will track down and investigate illegal meat supply operations across the state, according to Minister Vishwajit Rane. Strict monitoring will be enforced.

headline: Man Arrested for Raping 4-Year-Old in Canacona
summary: Police have arrested a man in Canacona for allegedly sexually assaulting a 4-year-old girl. This marks another child assault case registered in the state recently.

headline: 57th IFFI in Goa Set for November 20, 2026
summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India will commence in Goa on November 20, 2026. This edition will showcase films around the theme 'Stories Without Borders'.

summary: Travel details including stops, departure times, and route maps have been published for the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express. The train service aims to improve connectivity for tourists.

headline: 'Kantara' Included in IFFI International Competition
summary: Films such as 'Kantara' and 'The Kerala Story 2' have been selected for the international competition category at IFFI in Goa. The lineup showcases major Indian productions.

headline: Coastal Drill 'Sea Vigil 2026' Launched in Goa
summary: The 'Sea Vigil 2026' coastal security exercise has commenced off the coast of Goa. Defense forces are verifying security protocols across maritime borders.

summary: A native of Bihar has been taken into custody for allegedly raping a 4-year-old girl in Goa. Police confirmed this is the second child sexual assault case reported within a week.

summary: The Government College of Education in Chandigarh hosted an academic delegation from Goa. The visit focused on preparations and collaborative strategies for the ITEP curriculum.

summary: Former Goa Chief Minister Laxmikant Parsekar has re-entered the BJP after four years away from the party. He stated he is prepared to handle any assigned responsibilities.

summary: Authorities have designated official watersports zones across North Goa while making safety guidelines mandatory. Operators must comply with the new rules to continue service.

headline: Mumbai Native Arrested With Narcotics in Goa
summary: Goa Police arrested an individual from Mumbai after seizing narcotics valued at Rs 2.5 lakh. Legal proceedings have been initiated under drug enforcement laws.

headline: Burglary in Ponda Leads to Loss of Rs 15 Lakh
summary: Thieves looted valuables worth Rs 15 lakh during a residential burglary reported in Ponda. Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation.

summary: Goa Police have asked shack operators to conduct thorough background checks and verification for all hired staff. The measure aims to enhance coastal safety during the tourist season.

summary: Goa Police arrested 24 suspects across 16 states during a major anti-cybercrime drive. The inter-state operation targeted widespread financial and online fraud networks.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced plans to build a dedicated rail connection to Mopa Airport. The project aims to provide direct train access for air passengers.

summary: Following the departure of Gouramangi Singh, FC Goa is planning to hire a foreign head coach. The club aims to restructure its technical staff for the upcoming matches.

summary: Authorities plan to relocate 145 shop owners affected by the recent Vasco market fire. Temporary measures are being arranged to help business owners resume trading.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant will spearhead the BJP's campaign for the 2027 Goa Assembly elections. Party leadership expressed confidence in his governance track record.

headline: Laxmikant Parsekar Re-Inducted Into BJP
summary: Former Chief Minister Laxmikant Parsekar formally returned to the BJP after four years. Party leaders welcomed his return ahead of upcoming political organizational work.

headline: Goa Police Conduct Cyber Vigil 2.0 Raids
summary: Under Operation Cyber Vigil 2.0, Goa Police conducted coordinated raids in 16 states, apprehending 24 individuals. The crackdown targeted syndicates running multi-state cyber scams.

summary: Indian football captain Sunil Chhetri has suggested creating a dedicated reserve league. He emphasized that young domestic strikers need regular game time to develop.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted key infrastructure projects and political strategies during a recent state address. He outlined growth projections ahead of upcoming polls.

summary: A comprehensive fire safety audit will be conducted across Vasco markets on Monday. Officials will evaluate emergency compliance to prevent future fire incidents.

summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India will open in Goa on November 20 with the screening of 'Fatherland'. The festival features diverse global cinema entries.

summary: Child rights advocates in Goa stressed the necessity of year-round protection frameworks beyond Children's Day celebrations. Enhanced institutional monitoring was recommended.

summary: Prominent films including 'Ramayana' and 'Fatherland' headline the lineup for the upcoming International Film Festival of India in Goa. Masterclasses and screenings will feature global directors.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant affirmed that only the BJP has the vision to drive Goa's infrastructure and economic development forward. He reviewed ongoing public works.

summary: Goa's official Census 2027 population count will commence on December 1, with self-enumeration opening on November 16. Residents can fill details online or offline.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant expressed confidence that the BJP will secure 30 seats in the upcoming Goa assembly polls. He added that independent candidates are welcome to support the party.

headline: CM Sawant Reviews Tenure Ahead of Upcoming Elections
summary: Goa CM Pramod Sawant reflected on his term in office, focusing on rural development and state infrastructure. He outlined key priorities for his party's campaign.

summary: Police filed an FIR against a headmistress and a teacher for failing to report the sexual assault of a minor in a school toilet. Legal action was taken under mandatory reporting laws.

summary: Goa Police carried out synchronized raids across 16 states under Operation Cyber Vigil 2.0. The operation aimed at dismantling networks responsible for complex online fraud.

summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the new Vande Bharat train will enhance economic and tourism ties between Goa and Karnataka. Improved transit is expected to aid regional trade.

summary: The upcoming International Film Festival of India will feature 159 movies representing 86 countries. The event aims to promote global cinema under the 'Stories Without Borders' theme.

summary: FC Goa has officially ended its contract with coach Gouramangi Singh during the ISL 2026-27 season. The club is evaluating candidates to lead the team moving forward.

summary: Organizers have budgeted Rs 30 crore for the 57th IFFI edition in Goa. Over 7,000 delegates have registered to attend the multi-day festival.

summary: Electronic music festival DGTL India is expanding its footprint to Goa in 2026 while retaining its annual Bengaluru event in November. Dates and venue details will follow.

summary: FC Goa and head coach Gouramangi Singh have mutually separated after a difficult start to the 2026-27 season. Management is searching for a replacement.

summary: A luxury bus traveling on the Mumbai-Goa highway overturned after colliding with a truck, leaving 27 passengers injured. Emergency teams rescued trapped occupants from the vehicle.

summary: Laxmikant Parsekar has formally rejoined the Bharatiya Janata Party after a four-year absence. His return is expected to strengthen the party's local leadership.
